end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Used examples such as the ground line, slide, letter आ, and flagpole.
Om identified 2 of 4 examples without help.
Discussed that straightness means no bend, while standing, sleeping and slanting describe direction.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the three line directions using familiar objects and drawings. Om explained that a ground line is sleeping and that a slanting line is tilted; they also correctly separated a line’s direction from whether it is straight. The slide caused a brief mix-up because its shape can look curved, and this was clarified later by focusing on the straight, unbent part. At home, ask Om to find and name one standing, one sleeping, and one slanting straight line around the room.
